name: Flame detector
summary: Provides electrical indication that combustion flame is present or absent.
description: Provides electrical indication that combustion flame is present or absent.

In a drafting package, connect this reference to the burner or combustion equipment and detector supply. The associated drawing should trace the flame-proven permissive and fuel shutdown chain; the number identifies the role and does not specify the terminal arrangement, ratings or operating settings.
readingNotes: Identify the burner or combustion equipment and detector supply.
Trace the flame-proven permissive and fuel shutdown chain.
drawingChecklist: Label the burner or combustion equipment and detector supply.
Cross-reference the flame-proven permissive and fuel shutdown chain.
Identify the device tag, manual revision and logic drawing that define this implementation.
distinction: A flame detector supervises combustion; it is not a smoke detector or electrical arc-flash sensor.
